name: Live (Nextcloud)
description: Edit Nextcloud files live with the people who have them open in Nextcloud Office or in a craft app, through a craft-live server. Needs craft plugin protocol 2.
author: Marco Montanari and the craft-live contributors

addins.why: Shares its Nextcloud accounts, and Share Live works on the files it opened

commands.label: Open Live
commands.description: Open a Nextcloud file and edit it live with everyone who has it open

commands.label: Share Live
commands.description: Make the open document live as its Nextcloud file (or a given one)

commands.label: Join Live
commands.description: Join a file's live session from its Nextcloud link (…/f/<id>)

commands.label: Leave Live Session
commands.description: Leave the live session (the document stays open)

commands.label: Live Status
commands.description: The live sessions and who's in them

commands.label: Connect to Nextcloud
commands.description: Sign in to a Nextcloud (Login Flow v2)

commands.label: Choose Account
commands.description: Pick the account to browse (from a dialog)

commands.label: Live Settings
commands.description: The craft-live server of each Nextcloud

commands.label: Save Live Settings
commands.description: Store the settings (from the Settings dialog)
